integrity: Statements and derivations are original here; prior literature is explicitly attributed; finite checker supplements, but does not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite propositional vocabularies; lax split disjunction; Boolean negation restricted to classical formulas. No claims for first-order languages, infinite valuation domains, or translation-size optimality. Other terminology may conceal equivalent observations.
title: Depth-one expressive completeness for two epistemic team conditionals and the flatness boundary of a third
